tasks.short: Instruct recreational participants and explain safety precautions

steps.what: Instruct participants in recreational techniques and provide safety precautions adapted to conditions

tasks.design: Keep practical instruction and safety explanation with the worker. Approved precautions in {DOCS} can support demonstration without reducing live instruction time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participants need observation, adapted demonstration and immediate correction.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference materials are available but do not establish a substitute for practical teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Matching instruction to ability and changing environmental hazards.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising misunderstanding and helping a participant practise safely.
tasks.altitude: Instruction time and safety responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Adapt a practical exercise to ability

evidence.claim: Keeping practical recreational instruction human is an E1 judgement; the digest has no relevant instruction automation case.

assumptions: Boundary is direct instruction and precautions, excluding separate publication of training materials.
Worker elicits ability and observes conditions during fully retained s1; no structured ability score is assumed.
Zero upkeep because no new software or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Activity hazards and participant support requirements
research_questions: Which precautions require individual practical demonstration?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net zero. Live practical instruction is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe recreational areas for hazards and safety infractions

steps.what: Observe assigned areas using binoculars and assess hazards, disturbances and safety infractions

tasks.design: Retain continuous human observation with binoculars. A site plan in {DOCS} defines coverage, but camera analytics are not assumed to replace this safety function.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hazards depend on movement, terrain, visibility and context.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest does not establish recreational hazard detection suitable for reducing staffed observation.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting a small sign of distress amid ordinary activity.
tasks.human_edge: Contextual vigilance and recognition of deteriorating conditions.
tasks.altitude: Observation coverage and staffing time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review observation coverage and blind spots

evidence.claim: Recreational hazard observation remains human in this E1 design judgement; retail gesture analysis does not demonstrate this capability.

assumptions: Boundary is observation and hazard assessment, excluding rescue and incident reporting.
Worker directly observes conditions in s1; there is no free hazard flag, automatic classification or hidden camera review.
Zero upkeep because no new monitoring technology is introduced.
unknowns: Visibility, coverage zones and local staffing requirements
research_questions: Which observation areas have blind spots needing changed coverage?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, gross0 and net0; continuous observation remains fully staffed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist staff selection, training and supervision

steps.what: Assess staff candidates through observed practical competence and provide selection advice
Prepare training sessions and approve staff assignments, content and dates
Provide practical staff training and assess safe performance
Supervise staff during operations and correct unsafe practice

tasks.design: Configure reusable training plans in {LMS} and session templates in {CALENDAR}, using approved materials from {DOCS}. The worker checks each assignment while retaining candidate assessment, practical teaching and live supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Session preparation repeats established content and logistics between training cohorts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native enrolment and recurring session features reduce repeated preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Judging practical competence and correcting unsafe conduct.
tasks.human_edge: Observing performance and giving specific, timely coaching.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated session preparation; no new hiring or certification authority.

evidence.claim: Native learning assignments and reusable session plans can reduce repeated preparation; this task-specific design and saving are E1 assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is this worker's assistance, excluding the hiring manager's final decision and staff attendance time.

Worker captures trainee identifiers, module versions, session dates and availability in s2; its ten remaining hours include first capture, checks and approval. Missing availability is resolved manually within s2.
Test native learning and calendar features first; no automatic candidate ranking or practical competence score is introduced.
Two incremental hours per 100 baseline hours cover training template and assignment-rule upkeep.
unknowns: Current training systems, recurring modules and selection responsibilities
research_questions: Does repeated session preparation shrink after capture and approval time are included?

already_counted.description: Training input capture, assignment checks and approval

approvals.approved_version: Exact trainee list, module versions, session content and dates; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90; gross10 less2 upkeep gives8 net. Irregular training may save only2 preparation hours, giving zero net; all practical work remains unchanged.

role.altitude: Maintain live recreational safety while reducing repeated staff-training preparation.
reach: Review sightline coverage with the safety supervisor
Maintain practical modules with the training coordinator
role.ambitious_version: Consistent training preparation with fully retained practical instruction and vigilance.
